description:
Spotify widget for the desktop, with lyrics across the top of the screen and search from any app.

LinerFM is a music player companion for Mac and Windows 10 and 11, with Spotify. It gives you the widget, search from any app, lyrics across the top of the screen, a live desktop, a screensaver, AI playlists, your listening stats and Last.fm. Updates install on their own. Free for 3 days, then 10 EUR once.
